title: Intermediate categorical paste for internal-left scalar tensor transport
statement: Given the normalized tensor, scalar counit, and qTensor equations for P and Q, the derived-side scalar tensor input followed by barB, the two output counits, and qTensor equals scalarTensorSectionPath.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A4, categorical reassociation in the tensor localization proof.

proof.text: Use naturality of barB on the two section localization isomorphisms. Postcompose TensorSectionCondition by the pair of forward scalar comparison maps and cancel the inverse pair. This expresses the initial path through the section image of b.

Apply section_scalar_normalization separately to P and Q, then map both equations through the section tensor bifunctor. This replaces the two derived scalar comparisons and model counits by the two internal compute maps, output section localization isomorphisms, and localized ordinary comparisons.

Use naturality of the output qTensor on the ordinary comparison maps. Apply the representative normalization of section_derived_tensor_normalization at the extended internal complexes and cancel the two output section localization isomorphisms. Naturality of tensorComparison moves the pair of compute maps back to the internal tensor.

Cancel the remaining tensor comparison with its inverse. Functoriality combines the section images of b, the tensor of the compute maps, and the internal localization tensor map. Substitute hbn. The reflexive cochain comparison in scalarTensorSectionPath is the identity, so the resulting composite is exactly its defining path.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YY and 07A4; direct naturality paste using the output representative normalization and scalar normalization on P and Q.
